limitations: Observed best metrics may be partial or baseline-only; failed arms are not completed quality evidence.
Overlapping training-start windows and repeated search seeds are not independent financial samples.
Search seeds are not provider random seeds. Estimator seed is fixed at 42.
Lower fit use caused by provider failure is not demonstrated research efficiency.
Known token totals exclude failed calls with no usage; monetary cost and human minutes are unknown.
Provider errors are stored as RuntimeError without private exception text; timeout/quota/rate-limit root cause cannot be assigned from those records alone.
No deterministic fallback, no retry of failed arms to select winners, no superiority claim.
